description: BRACE-RW E0 variance gate, corrected rerun authorized by BRACE_RW_PLAN.md direction-switch clause 2 (sigma2_Q ~= 0 with saturated bimodal V_hat under v1). Three corrections vs brace_rw.e0.v1: (1) branch points restore the policy's full n_obs_steps observation history (v1 measured pi~0(a|o_t,o_t,o_t) after reset_obs, since the DP runner repeat-fills missing frames); (2) snapshots at every policy-chunk boundary with a consensus-divergence causal selector (v1 had only 3 quartile snapshots relabeled post hoc); (3) unclipped Delta as the primary gate quantity with a seed-cluster bootstrap and an exact conditional state-stratified randomization test (v1 gated on clipped Delta, which is upward biased under the null, and on the asymptotic Tarone Z, which is miscalibrated at R=2).

e0_variance_gate.point_selector: Chunk-boundary snapshots over the success trace; consensus divergence d_k = mean over ALL failure rollouts of the seed of the joint-space distance to the success state at boundary k; k* = argmax_k (d_{k+1} - d_k); pre_divergence_causal branches into chunk k*-1 (before the divergence grows), matched_random_control is drawn uniformly from boundaries outside the growth window {k*-1, k*, k*+1}.
e0_variance_gate.obs_history: Traced rollouts store the n_obs_steps encode_obs frames the policy consumed at each chunk boundary (branch_snapshots/obs_history, uint8-quantized cams, lossless for k/255 inputs). Branch and E0 harnesses restore this history into the DP runner deque before sampling/continuing, so sampled chunks follow pi0(a | o_{t-2}, o_{t-1}, o_t). Requires a traced corpus collected with --snapshot-mode chunk_boundary.
e0_variance_gate.rollout_dir_note: traced corpus must be re-collected with collect_traced_rollouts.py --snapshot-mode chunk_boundary (v1 corpus experiments/brace/rollouts_traced_base200_v2 lacks obs history and chunk-boundary snapshots); suggested dir: experiments/brace/rollouts_traced_base200_v3
e0_variance_gate.seed_independence: continuation seeds are derived per (task, env_seed, snapshot_id, action_index, continuation_index) via SHA-256; no common random numbers across actions, which would bias S2_between downward or upward
e0_variance_gate.budget_note: 32 mixed seeds x 2 points x 8 actions x 3 continuations = 1536 rollouts per task (same budget as v1)

gate.decision: PASS requires BOTH pooled mean UNCLIPPED Delta_hat_{c=3} >= 0.02 AND exact conditional state-stratified randomization one-sided p <= 0.05. Tarone Z is reported as a diagnostic only. PASS -> proceed to BRACE-RW training arms (B1'/B3'). FAIL -> Var_a[Q0] is genuinely too small at reachable branch states for return weighting to matter for this policy/task snapshot; the BRACE-RW line stops (this is the single authorized rerun under direction-switch clause 2; no further E0 reruns).

estimator.sigma2_Q: S2_between - S2_within / R (one-way random-effects ANOVA, unbiased for Var_a[Q])
estimator.delta_c: c * sigma2_Q / (1 + c * V_hat), UNCLIPPED as primary (clipped variant reported as diagnostic; E[max(sigma2,0)] > 0 under sigma2 = 0 inflates the pooled mean in the null regime)
estimator.uncertainty: seed-cluster bootstrap over env seeds (points within a seed share a trajectory and are not i.i.d.)
estimator.confirmatory: exact conditional state-stratified randomization test: permute each point's A x R outcomes across actions conditioning on the point total; statistic = pooled Tarone S; exact at any R
